inCommand.description: Whether the menu is in the "in command" state. Controls the toggle and visual state.

showLocation.description: Whether the menu draws the location of the command (the `command-location` text) beside its description.

commandIconName.description: The icon in the `command-icon` slot, by name (a bundled icon); empty puts none. Main icon representing the current command state.

commandStatus.description: The text in the `command-status` slot; empty puts none. Status label (e.g., "Joystick", "NO CMD").

commandDescription.description: The text in the `command-description` slot; empty puts none. Description of the command state.

commandLocation.description: The text in the `command-location` slot; empty puts none. Location label for the command (shown if showLocation is true).

takeCommandLabel.description: The text in the `toogle-action-to-in-command-label` slot; empty puts none. Label for the action to take command.

releaseCommandLabel.description: The text in the `toogle-action-to-no-command-label` slot; empty puts none. Label for the action to release command.

inCommandLabel.description: The text in the `toogle-state-in-command-label` slot; empty puts none. Status label when in "in command" state.

noCommandLabel.description: The text in the `toogle-state-no-command-label` slot; empty puts none. Status label when in "no command" state.

inCommandIconName.description: The icon in the `toogle-state-in-command-icon` slot, by name (a bundled icon); empty puts none. Icon for the "in command" state (defaults to <obi-command-in>).

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
